north_star: Converge turns Eidos product goals into ordered recursive matrix chains that improve through evidence rows, repair queues, research loops, and front-loaded human approvals.

convergence_style.why: The system must advance from planned rows to controlled harness proof to real account-sensitive browser proof without false green.

seed_cases.name: Surfari Knox Apple Developer profile-session workflow

linear_sync_policy.create_issue_when: A repair row is stable, high priority, has a clear target/probe gap, and cannot be fixed in the current small local slice.
linear_sync_policy.do_not_sync_when: The row is still exploratory, duplicates an existing EID, requires raw secrets, or depends on login/MFA/legal/payment/final submission authority.
